title: Chan (2003) test: for the same size of daily move, do names with a public 8-K catalyst continue while names with no public catalyst revert?
registered_by: EXECUTOR N1 (subagent); single run after registration; no thresholds changed after this file is hashed
run_policy: Run exactly once. Every reported variant is declared below; any extra variant is appended to things_tried.csv with who=N1 and is descriptive only (never promoted).

hypothesis.H_news: Large positive day-0 excess moves accompanied by an 8-K whose tradeable reaction session is T continue over T+1..T+20 (net excess > 0).
hypothesis.H_nonews: Large positive day-0 excess moves with no 8-K of any item in reaction sessions [T-1, T+1] revert (net excess < 0).
hypothesis.H_diff: NEWS minus NO-NEWS forward net excess > 0 at T+5 and/or T+20.
hypothesis.mirror: For day-0 <= -8%: NEWS drops continue (long-side excess < 0), NO-NEWS drops bounce (long-side excess > 0). Reported as a finding, not a pass.

data.filings: research/news8k_events.csv (701,481 8-K-family filings, 4,384 tickers, 2004-01..2026-09; all forms starting with 8-K incl. 8-K/A; items from items_new)
data.benchmark: research/EXEC_v5_SPY_2004_2026.csv; SPY dates define the trading calendar from 2004-01-01
data.ticker_mapping: filing tickers_all (pipe-split, upper) matched to bar files by symbol, then us_common_symbols.csv yf alias, then '.'->'-'; unmatched filings dropped and counted
data.survivorship: symbol list as of 2026-09; delisted names absent from both filings and bars; caveat, no haircut applied to point estimates (reported separately as +0.25%/+0.40% guidance from NEWSARCH)

universe_through_T_minus_1.adv20_definition: mean(Close*Volume) over the 20 sessions ending T-1, min 15 valid sessions
universe_through_T_minus_1.requires: Open_T, Close_T, Volume_T, Open_{T+1} all present

event_rows.UP3V_secondary: day0_excess >= +0.03 AND Volume_T >= 2.0 * ADV20_shares (mean Volume over 20 sessions ending T-1, min 15)
event_rows.event_unit: ticker-day; no dedupe (consecutive-day events kept; cluster CIs absorb dependence); events with T in the window and T+1 < end of data

reaction_session_rule.intra: 09:30 <= acceptance ET < 16:00 -> same session (first session >= et_date); flagged intra
reaction_session_rule.post: acceptance ET >= 16:00 -> first session strictly after et_date
reaction_session_rule.non_trading_et_date: pre/intra/post on a weekend/holiday -> next trading session

arms.NEWS: >= 1 filing of any item with reaction session == T
arms.NEWS_202: NEWS and >= 1 such filing carries item 2.02
arms.NEWS_non202: NEWS and no such filing carries item 2.02
arms.NONEWS: no filing of any item with reaction session in {T-1, T, T+1}
arms.AMBIG: filing at T-1 or T+1 but none at T; excluded from both arms, count reported
descriptive_only: NEWS split intra-only (all T filings intra) vs known-at-open (>= 1 pre or prior-day post)
NEWS_non202 by item code present at T (7.01, 8.01, 1.01, 2.01, 5.02, 3.02, 5.07, 5.03, 2.03, 3.01, 9.01-only); overlapping categories

costs_and_benchmark.round_trip_applied: 10 bp or 20 bp subtracted once per trade
costs_and_benchmark.net_excess: (exit/entry - 1) - (SPY exit/SPY entry - 1) - round_trip; SPY entry = SPY Close_T for MOC_T, SPY Open_{T+1} for MOO_T1; SPY exit = SPY Close at the same exit session
costs_and_benchmark.down_side_convention: DN8 cells are reported long-side: gross excess, net_long = gross - cost, net_short = -gross - cost

windows.DISC: T in 2005-01-01..2014-12-31 (bars1d_2004_2013 + 2014 from bars1d_10y; survivorship-heavy; descriptive)
windows.regime_split: TEST years 2020-2024 vs other TEST years, reported for UP8 NEWS/NONEWS at h=5,20 MOC_T
windows.yearly: per calendar year: n and mean net excess for NEWS and NONEWS (UP8, MOC_T, h=5 and 20) and NONEWS share

statistics.point: mean net excess per trade, percent
statistics.ci: 95% cluster bootstrap, 2,000 reps, seed 20260913; clusters = event day T and calendar quarter; the WIDER interval is reported (both stored)
statistics.p_value: one-sided bootstrap p in the declared direction, max over day/quarter clustering, floor 0.5/reps
statistics.difference: NEWS minus NONEWS (and NEWS_202 minus NONEWS, NEWS_non202 minus NONEWS): joint cluster bootstrap resampling days (and quarters), difference of arm means per rep; wider CI reported; one-sided p for diff > 0 on UP rows
statistics.years_positive: share of years with >= 10 events in the cell whose mean net excess is > 0
statistics.holm_family: exactly 6 cells: TEST x UP8 x MOC_T x no-exclusion x {NEWS, NONEWS} x {h=1, 5, 20}; Holm step-down on the declared-direction one-sided p; everything else descriptive

pass_rule_tradeable_claim.applies_to: NEWS arm, TEST, UP8, MOC_T (family cells); MOO_T1 reported alongside but not in the family
all_required: net excess lower CI (wider cluster) > 0 at that horizon
NEWS minus NONEWS difference lower CI > 0 at that horizon

finding_rule_nonews_reversion.statement: NONEWS UP8 TEST MOC_T mean net excess < 0 with upper CI (wider cluster) < 0 at h=5 or h=20 -> 'no-news big moves revert' is a supported finding and justifies an exclusion rule; reported with Holm p from the same family

N5_exclusion_variant.rule: drop the event if the ticker has any filing carrying item 3.02, 4.02, 3.01, 1.03 or 5.03 whose reaction session lies in [T-60, T] (60 prior sessions plus day 0)
N5_exclusion_variant.reporting: every long (UP) cell reported with and without the exclusion; the exclusion is adopted only if it raises the NEWS cell excess with non-overlapping CIs (NEWSARCH N5 rule); no pass decision changes because of it

outputs.sha_sidecar: research/N1_prereg_sha256.txt (SHA-256 of this file computed at run start)
outputs.things_tried: append rows with who=N1 for every reported cell and variant
